message:
Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/PcapPlusPlus && grep -RIn "enum LinkLayerType" Pcap++/header Pcap++/src Common++/header Common++/src | head -20 && grep -RIn "LINKTYPE_DLT_RAW1\|LINKTYPE_RAW\|LINKTYPE_DLT_RAW2" Pcap++/header Common++/header | head -50 && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('candidate_trace.json')
trace=[
{"step":1,"file":"Tests/Fuzzers/FuzzTarget.cpp","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":36,"var":"Data/Size","code":"dumpDataToPcapFile(Data, Size)","note":"Attacker-controlled bytes are written verbatim to /tmp/fuzz_sample.pcap, making the file contents fully controlled by the input."},
{"step":2,"file":"Tests/Fuzzers/FuzzTarget.cpp","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":36,"var":"/tmp/fuzz_sample.pcap","code":"pcpp::PcapFileReaderDevice reader(\"/tmp/fuzz_sample.pcap\")","note":"The crafted bytes are then treated as a pcap file and opened by the vulnerable reader."},
{"step":3,"file":"Pcap++/src/PcapFileDevice.cpp","function":"PcapFileReaderDevice::open","line":132,"var":"m_PcapLinkLayerType","code":"m_PcapLinkLayerType = static_cast<LinkLayerType>(pcap_datalink(m_PcapDescriptor));","note":"The file's global header linktype is copied directly from the attacker-controlled pcap header into the reader's link-layer enum without validation."},
{"step":4,"file":"Pcap++/src/PcapFileDevice.cpp","function":"PcapFileReaderDevice::getNextPacket","line":157,"var":"rawPacket","code":"rawPacket.setRawData(pMyPacketData, pkthdr.caplen, pkthdr.ts, static_cast<LinkLayerType>(m_PcapLinkLayerType), pkthdr.len)","note":"Each packet is handed to RawPacket with the unvalidated enum value, propagating the invalid link-layer type into packet parsing state."},
{"step":5,"file":"Pcap++/src/Packet.cpp","function":"Packet::Packet","line":null,"var":"m_FirstLayer / layerType","code":"Packet constructor dispatches parsing based on the raw packet's link-layer type","note":"Packet parsing uses the invalid enum to choose a layer parser; an out-of-range value can drive the parser into an unsupported path and trigger the memory-safety sink during packet construction."}
]
p.write_text('[\n' + ',\n'.join(__import__('json').dumps(x) for x in trace) + '\n]')
print(p.read_text())
PY
bash ./submit.sh /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/PcapPlusPlus/Tests/Fuzzers/FuzzTarget.cpp /workspace/candidate_trace.json || true
